name: get_capabilities
description: Call this first. Returns what each enabled video, audio and image backend accepts (aspects, length limits, reference and keyframe limits, quality modes), the prompt tag syntax (<Picture N>, <Video N>, <Audio N>), render-time estimates, guardrail settings, and whether a GPU worker is up right now.

name: create_upload
description: Get a presigned HTTPS PUT URL for one input file (reference image, keyframe, reference video, reference audio, or soundtrack). Upload the bytes with: curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>' --upload-file <file> '<upload_url>'. Then pass the returned key to generate_video. URLs expire after 15 minutes; uploaded inputs are deleted after the stack's input retention period.

filename.description: Original file name, used for the extension (e.g. singer.png, song.wav, move.mp4).

content_type.description: MIME type sent with the PUT, e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, audio/wav, audio/mpeg, video/mp4.

name: generate_video
description: Queue one video generation and return a job_id immediately (renders take minutes; get_capabilities has estimates). Poll get_job until status is SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED or CANCELLED. With backend h3 the model makes picture and sound in one pass: put any sung or spoken line in the prompt in quotes, whole. Reference media are tagged in the prompt in upload order: refs -> <Picture 1..n>, then first_frame/keyframes/last_frame continue the <Picture> numbering; ref_videos -> <Video n>; ref_audios -> <Audio n>. On h3 a soundtrack makes the character lip-sync to real audio; on wan2.2 it is muxed onto the silent render. Add identity_check to have the clip checked against the character's reference images.

backend.description: Model backend: wan2.2 (default, Apache-2.0, silent 720p video, text or first-frame to video) or h3 (MiniMax-H3: picture + sound in one pass, references, keyframes, lip-sync; only if the operator enabled it). get_capabilities lists what is enabled.

prompt.description: Scene, action, camera and energy in 1-3 sentences. Quote every line that is sung or spoken. Max 4000 characters.

seconds.description: Clip length, 5-15 (the trained range). Default 5, or the soundtrack length when one is given. Snapped to the model's frame cadence.

quality.description: full (default, best detail and lip-sync), balanced (wan2.2 only: a few full-strength steps, then the 4-step LoRA; real motion at about a quarter of full's time), draft8 or draft4 (turbo LoRAs, fastest).

model.description: singularity (default, the Singularity v1.3 community fine-tune) or ref2va (stock MiniMax-H3 ref2va).

seed.description: Fix for a repeatable take. Random if omitted.

refs.description: Up to 9 reference images (identity, costume, location). Not pinned to a time. (h3 only)

ref_videos.description: Up to 3 reference videos (motion or camera move, 2-15 s). Their soundtrack rides along. Note: the model copies the subject of a ref video, not only its motion. (h3 only)

ref_audios.description: Up to 3 reference audio clips (a voice or music to match). (h3 only)

first_frame.description: Upload key of the image pinned as frame 0. A real photoreal start frame is the biggest quality lever.

last_frame.description: Upload key of the image pinned as the final frame.

keyframes.description: Images pinned at a time. Keep camera moves to about 3 pins per 7 s, and make the pins agree on the world, or the model hard-cuts between them. (h3 only)

at.description: Seconds from the start; negative counts from the end.

soundtrack.description: Audio anchored onto the output; on-camera singing or speech lip-syncs to it.

from.description: Trim start in the source file, seconds.

at.description: Where it starts in the output, seconds. Default 0.

keep_original.description: Replace the model's decoded audio with the original file in the final mp4 (use for songs and VO). Default true.

idempotency_key.description: Any string; retries with the same key return the same job instead of queueing a duplicate.

labels.description: Free-form string labels stored on the job (project, cost center, shot id).

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid (wan2.2). A sensible default is applied.

recipe.description: Pin a named render recipe (frozen sampler, LoRA, prompt-rewrite and finishing settings) for reproducible output, e.g. r0 (original), r1, r2. get_capabilities lists each backend's recipes and default.

tuning.description: Advanced: override single recipe knobs for an experiment, e.g. {"steps": 50} or {"interpolate": 2}. get_capabilities lists the knobs and allowed values.

identity_check.description: Check the finished clip is still the same character: Amazon Rekognition compares the faces in 8 evenly spaced frames with the reference images. Pass {} to use refs, or give reference. get_job returns identity: PASS (every clear frame matches), FAIL (a clear frame shows a different face, e.g. a hidden cut), or REVIEW (close call, or no clear face), with per-frame scores. The job still succeeds either way.

reference.description: 1-5 reference images: the character sheet and/or approved images. Default: refs.

pass_at.description: Score needed to PASS on a clear face. Default 97 (calibrated).

review_at.description: Below this on a clear face is a FAIL; between review_at and pass_at is REVIEW. Default 90.

min_face.description: Faces shorter than this many pixels go to REVIEW: the score is unreliable there. Default 100.

name: generate_audio
description: Queue one audio generation (Stable Audio 3: stereo music, instruments, sound effects or one-shots from a text prompt) and return a job_id immediately. Poll get_job for audio_url (WAV) and mp3_url. Describe genre, instruments, mood, tempo (BPM) and structure for music; the source, space and action for sound effects.

prompt.description: What to generate, e.g. 'Warm lo-fi hip hop beat, dusty vinyl drums, mellow Rhodes chords, 82 BPM' or 'Heavy wooden door creaks open in a stone hallway, slow, reverberant'.

model.description: medium (default, best quality, music and SFX), small-music or small-sfx (faster).

idempotency_key.description: Retries with the same key return the same job.

labels.description: Free-form string labels for cost_report (project, cost_center).

name: generate_image
description: Queue one image job and return a job_id immediately; poll get_job for image_url (and images, one entry per image when count > 1). Backends: qwen-image (default; Qwen-Image text to PNG, about 1.6 MP, about 30 s warm, strong at lettering) and h3-image (MiniMax-H3-Image: about 16 MP photoreal or illustrated text-to-image, or an edit of up to 16 reference images; 6 steps, no CFG, no negative prompt). For h3-image name references in the prompt as <Picture 1> ... <Picture 16> in refs order (<Picture 1> is the image to edit); a short prompt is expanded server-side into the detailed caption the model expects (tuning.enhance_prompt, on by default), which also picks the canvas when aspect is auto. Describe subject, setting, light, lens and style; put any text that must appear in the image in quotes.

prompt.description: What to draw, e.g. 'Rainy Tokyo side street at night, neon sign reading OPEN, 35mm photo, shallow depth of field'.

aspect.description: qwen-image: 16:9 (default, 1664x928), 9:16, 1:1 (1328x1328), 4:3 or 3:4. h3-image: auto (default: the expander picks, else the edited image's ratio, else 1:1), 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:5, 5:4, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9.

count.description: Images from this prompt, 1-4. Default 1. Image i uses seed + i, so any one re-renders alone with count 1.

quality.description: h3-image: full (default, about 16 MP) or draft (about 4 MP, faster).

refs.description: h3-image: up to 16 reference images, each {key} from create_upload; <Picture N> in the prompt is refs[N-1] and <Picture 1> is the image to edit.

tuning.description: h3-image: {enhance_prompt: false} sends your prompt to the model unchanged (write a full, detailed English caption). {easyfix: on | off | compare} for text-to-image: on (default) draws cleaner skin, fur and stone; off is the stock sampler, a rougher and more rugged look; compare returns both for each seed, EasyFix first (images[].easyfix says which), at twice the render. It is another way of drawing, not a polish, so on and off are different pictures of the same prompt. Edits of reference images are always stock.

steps.description: qwen-image only: sampling steps, 10-50. Default 30. (h3-image is fixed at 6.)

cfg.description: qwen-image only: prompt guidance, 1-10. Default 3.0. (h3-image is fixed at 1.)

negative_prompt.description: qwen-image only: what to avoid. Default 'blurry, lowres, deformed, watermark'.

idempotency_key.description: Retries with the same key return the same job.

labels.description: Free-form string labels for cost_report (project, cost_center).

name: check_identity
description: Is this image the same character as the reference images? Answers in a few seconds, no GPU. Amazon Rekognition compares every face on the references (each panel of a character sheet, plus approved images) with the faces in the image and keeps the best match, 0-100. verdict: PASS (>= pass_at on a clear face), FAIL (under review_at on a clear face), or REVIEW (in between, or the face is too small or covered to judge, where scores are unreliable either way: have a person look). Upload both with create_upload first. Calibrated on AI characters and look-alikes with the same hair, makeup and outfits.

reference.description: 1-5 reference images of the character: the character sheet and/or approved images.

image.description: Key (from create_upload) of the PNG, JPEG or WebP image to check.

pass_at.description: Score needed to PASS on a clear face. Default 97 (calibrated).

review_at.description: Below this on a clear face is a FAIL; between review_at and pass_at is REVIEW. Default 90.

min_face.description: Faces shorter than this many pixels go to REVIEW: the score is unreliable there. Default 100.

name: get_job
description: Status of one job: QUEUED, STARTING, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED (failed a content check) or CANCELLED, plus phase, timings, and on success presigned URLs for the mp4 and a poster frame (audio jobs: audio_url and mp3_url; image jobs: image_url and images), plus the provenance manifest (valid for 1 hour by default; call again for fresh URLs). Jobs submitted with identity_check also return identity (verdict, reason, per-frame scores).

name: list_jobs
description: Your recent jobs, newest first, with status and prompt preview.

status.description: Optional filter: QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED or CANCELLED.

name: cancel_job
description: Cancel a queued or running job. A running render is interrupted on the GPU.

name: gpu_capacity
description: See or steer the GPU fleet. status = instances, spot or on-demand, boot phase, queue depth. warm = start one worker now so the next job skips the ~5 min cold start. release = scale to zero when nothing is running. use_on_demand / use_spot = switch the purchase option when spot capacity is short.

name: cost_report
description: Chargeback for your jobs: exact GPU cost per job (time on the GPU x the live spot or on-demand price), totals and USD per second of video, grouped by backend or by one of your job labels (e.g. project or cost_center). Also reports the fleet's total instance-hours, which include boot and idle time.

group_by_label.description: A label key you set on generate_video (labels), e.g. project. Default: group by backend.
